hooks.name: Orientation check on hero picture save
hooks.description: When a hero picture under assets/poses or assets/units is saved, compare the repository with the frozen orientation set and print the differences, so a facing is never changed by accident (re-freeze only after looking at the picture).

action.command: python3 -B scripts/freeze_orientation.py || echo 'orientation set differs: check that the picture faces LEFT, then run scripts/freeze_orientation.py --write'
